properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Define Centralized Authenticator Inventory
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Maintain an approved list of system authenticators, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews. (IAM-45).

metadata.Description:
"Centralized Authenticator Inventory
- Create a centralized inventory of all approved authenticators across all cloud platforms.
- Include details such as authenticator type, strength, associated cloud platform, and expiration date.
Authenticator Categories
1. Categorize authenticators based on their type and strength:
- High-Security Authenticators: Hardware security keys (FIDO2) for privileged accounts
- Standard Authenticators: Software-based TOTP apps for regular user accounts
- Legacy Authenticators: SMS-based OTP (to be phased out)
Authenticator Lifecycle Management
1. Implement a process for adding new authenticators to the approved list
2. Set up automated reminders for authenticator expiration and renewal
3. Define procedures for revoking compromised or outdated authenticators
